subject: Vision endpoint available for desktop assistant (RTX 5060 via Tailscale)
body: The Ubuntu host now reads its desktop via the operator's Windows desktop ollama over Tailscale. Any agent or the operator's desktop-assistant can reuse the same endpoint: ollama at http://100.95.92.117:11434, vision models qwen3.5:2b (fast) / qwen3.5:4b (better) / qwen3.5:0.8b, plus Bonsai-27B-gguf:Q1_0. Vision requests: POST /api/generate with model, prompt, images[] (base64 PNG), stream=false, think=false. Capture on the Ubuntu side: gnome-screenshot -f <file> (full Wayland). Local Ubuntu ollama runs only nomic-embed-text embeddings (operator directive: no large local models).
